$schema: clone-website extraction artifact — consumed by scripts/emit-design-system.ts
name: Reworkd

extraction.method: Playwright Chromium computed-style inspection, first-party stylesheet inspection, interaction sweep, public asset inventory, and 1440px/768px/390px captures
extraction.evidence: Original references and component specifications are retained in docs/design-references/reworkd-ai and docs/research/reworkd-ai.
extraction.note: A precise, airy data-infrastructure system pairs charcoal typography and cool white surfaces with a narrow electric-blue signal.

--bg.reason: The primary marketing canvas resolves to white across the problem, feature, and footer regions.
--bg.source: live 1440px capture and page wrapper computed backgrounds

--surface.reason: Source inactive controls and technical cards use the shark-50 surface.
--surface.source: live hero tab computed background: rgb(244, 247, 247)

--surface-warm.reason: The source hero and problem transitions use a pale blue data-atmosphere layer.

--fg.reason: Live body and primary headings resolve to shark-950.

--fg-2.reason: Raised dark UI surfaces and secondary emphasis use shark-800.
--fg-2.source: first-party Tailwind palette in live stylesheet

--muted.reason: Live mono labels and supporting copy resolve to shark-600.
--muted.source: live section kicker computed color: rgb(82, 96, 104)

--meta.reason: Low-emphasis captions and footer metadata use shark-500.
--meta.source: first-party Tailwind palette in live stylesheet

--border.reason: The selected hero tab and technical frames use shark-200 hairlines.
--border.source: live selected hero tab computed border: rgb(203, 211, 214)

--border-soft.reason: The source repeatedly uses shark-100 for internal grid divisions.

--accent.reason: The gradient highlight and action system are anchored by azure-500.
--accent.source: live hero headline data image and CSS: #3E79EA

--accent-on.reason: Primary blue controls use white foreground copy.
--accent-on.source: live hero CTA inner label computed style

--accent-hover.reason: Source interactive extractor CTA declares this hover blue.

--accent-active.reason: Source blue borders and pressed treatments resolve to azure-800.

--success.reason: Green source status chips are mapped to the standard accessible success role.
--success.source: live hero browser Active status chips

--warn.reason: The page has no dedicated warning role; this completes the portable semantic contract.
--warn.source: semantic fallback mapped from OpenDesign schema

--danger.reason: Cancelled rows use a subdued red semantic role; this completes the portable contract.
--danger.source: live hero browser Cancelled status row

--font-display.reason: Hero and section headings use the downloaded Selecta medium face.

--font-body.reason: Live body, navigation, and product UI use Suisse Intl.

--font-mono.value: "Reworkd Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
--font-mono.reason: Question labels, source URLs, and technical UI use Geist Mono.

--text-xs.reason: Source mono section labels render at 12px.

--text-sm.reason: Source footer links, control labels, and compact copy use the 14px tier.

--text-lg.reason: Feature card titles use the source’s 18px display tier.

--space-3.reason: Compact card padding and metadata gaps use 12px.
